source_citation: Mission physics criteria derive exclusively from repo-verified artifacts: 02/03/04/05/06/07/08 reference-library JSONs and Phase 0 verified primitives. Every pass criterion is a machine-checkable physics condition (solver output threshold), never a subjective statement.

missions.title: Transistor IV Curves
missions.objective: Place an SKY130 NMOS + voltage rail + load resistor; sweep gate voltage; observe the square-law IV family in the oscilloscope dock.

pass_criteria.condition: Id at Vgs=1.8 V within ±5% of the square-law reference: Id = 0.5·KP·(Vgs−Vth)²·(1+λ·Vds) with KP=0.004 A/V², Vth=0.55 V (02 JSON)
Id at Vgs=0.6 V < 1% of Id at Vgs=1.8 V (sub-threshold off state)

missions.title: Gate-Oxide SOA & TDDB
missions.objective: Push VDD past the 1.95 V SKY130 core ceiling and capture the oxide-breakdown forensic autopsy.

pass_criteria.condition: gate_oxide_breakdown event with value > 1.95 V and threshold == 1.95 (06 JSON)
E-model TDDB equation string present: ln(TTF) = ln(A) − γ·Vgs, γ ≈ 300 dec/V
AI Fix clamps VDD ≤ 1.80 V and the re-run is clean (no failure event)

missions.failure_mode_teaches: SKY130 core SOA ceiling; hard breakdown at ≥3 V shorted-gate fault

missions.title: Copper Trace Fusing
missions.objective: Route a 3 µm-wide trace under a 3 V rail and 20 Ω load; watch Joule heating reach the Cu melting point.

pass_criteria.condition: trace_fusing event with traceTempC ≥ 1085 °C (06 JSON cu_melting_c)
P = I²·R(T) + Onderdonk equation string present

missions.failure_mode_teaches: electro-thermal feedback R(T) = R₀(1+α(T−T₀)); 260 °C FR-4 delamination contrast mission available

missions.title: Q4 Inverter Noise Margins
missions.objective: Drive the verified q4_inv cell across all four input digits and measure per-level noise margins.

pass_criteria.condition: for each input level Lk ∈ {0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8} V the output lands within ±0.3 V of the mapped level 3−k (03 JSON q4_inv transfer)
per-level noise margin ≥ VDD/(2·(R−1)) = 0.3 V (03 JSON noise_margin_bounds)

missions.title: Package Your First Custom IC
missions.objective: Compose a working circuit into a reusable black-box custom IC with auto-extracted macro-model.

pass_criteria.condition: extracted timing arcs within ±5% and dynamic power within ±10% of the internal netlist solve (custom-ic.schema.json contract)
the IC instantiates in a fresh schematic and reproduces its internal behavior through the macro-model

missions.title: Systolic TPU Matmul & Utilization
missions.objective: Run a 32×32 INT8 GEMM on the 8×8 systolic array; read utilization, cycles, and per-tile heat.

pass_criteria.condition: C matrix equals exact INT8-accumulated reference math (chip-engine test oracle)
cycles = ceil(M/8)·ceil(N/8)·(K+2·8−2) (05 JSON systolic cycle equation)
per-tile activity drives Fourier thermal colors (0..1 normalized)

missions.failure_mode_teaches: utilization loss on small matrices; INT32 accumulator bounds (K ≤ 33038)

missions.title: Unified Memory vs Discrete PCIe
missions.objective: Run the same inference under discrete-PCIE and unified-memory architectures and compare cycles/bandwidth/energy.

setup.workload: memory-bound M=1 N=4096 K=4096 GEMV (LLM-decode shape)

pass_criteria.condition: unified-memory total cycles < discrete-PCIE total cycles (zero-copy: weights resident)
Q4 NPU bytes-on-bus < INT8 NPU bytes-on-bus (2 digits/byte packing)
results carry the SIMULATED_ARCHITECTURAL_MODEL badge

missions.failure_mode_teaches: Roofline: memory-bound workloads amplify architecture differences

missions.title: DVFS Thermal Throttling
missions.objective: Push tile frequency until the junction hits the 200 °C Si thermal-runaway alarm; observe throttling.

pass_criteria.condition: si_thermal_runaway warn event at ≥ 200 °C junction (06 JSON)
DVFS loop reduces frequency when T > 125 °C envelope max (05 JSON valid_operating_envelope)

missions.failure_mode_teaches: P = αCV²f vs. leakage doubling every ~10 °C above onset

missions.title: T1/T2 Decay Under Real Noise
missions.objective: Prepare |1⟩, watch amplitude damping decay; verify against the analytic exponential.

setup.device: transmon (04 JSON: T1 = 100 µs, T2 = 150 µs)

pass_criteria.condition: population(T1) = e⁻¹ ± 0.02 of the analytic value (Lindblad test oracle)
coherence(T2) = 0.5·e⁻¹ ± 0.02

missions.title: Cryogenic Quench Forensics
missions.objective: Overdrive the 15 mK mixing chamber past 12 mW and capture the quench collapse.

setup.device: dilution cryostat (06 JSON: Q_cool(15 mK) = 12 mW)

pass_criteria.condition: cryo_quench event when Q_load > 12 mW (strict >)
dT/dt = (Q_load − Q_cool(T))/C_th drives stage past the 1.2 K Al Tc; all Bloch spheres collapse

missions.failure_mode_teaches: quadratic dilution cooling Q ∝ (T/100 mK)²; ≈4 h real recovery time

missions.title: Error Correction Beats Physics
missions.objective: Run the Pauli-frame QEC sweep and show logical error < physical error.

setup.device: d3 repetition surface segment + 3-qubit bit-flip code

pass_criteria.condition: logical error rate at p = 0.05 strictly below the physical rate (quadratic suppression)
fixed seed reproduces the exact sweep table

missions.failure_mode_teaches: syndrome extraction, weight-1 decoding, threshold behavior

grading_note: All pass criteria are evaluated by the platform's own solver outputs and unit-test oracles — the Academy never grades on visual appearance, only on machine-checkable physics.
